home.title: Together, we help our community thrive.
home.intro: A place to connect, lend a hand, and have a voice. Welcome to the Thrive Center for Success Parent–Teacher Organization.
home.imageAlt: Illustrated school garden with a tree, a welcoming bench, and colorful classroom windows. Temporary artwork, not a photograph of the Thrive campus.
home.pathsIntro: Find the way to get involved that works for you and your family.
home.eventsTitle: Good things to look forward to
home.eventsIntro: Keep an eye here for upcoming PTO events and ways to connect.
home.volunteerTitle: An hour. A helping hand. A difference.
home.volunteerIntro: Volunteers help make so many of the special moments at Thrive possible. Whether you have an hour to give or want to take on a larger role, we'd love to have you join us—but there's never any pressure. Every contribution is appreciated.
home.membershipTitle: Have a voice in what comes next.
home.membershipIntro: Some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote. Your membership gives you a voice in those decisions.
home.contactIntro: Questions about the PTO or your membership? We're here to help.

about.title: Our school. Our community. Our PTO.
about.intro: Welcome to the Parent–Teacher Organization for Thrive Center for Success.
about.boardTitle: Led by our board and our members
about.boardBody: The Thrive PTO is led by a PTO Board and its members. Some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote, giving members a voice in what comes next.
about.volunteerTitle: There's a place for your contribution
about.volunteerBody: Whether you have an hour to give or want to take on a larger role, we'd love to have you join us—but there's never any pressure. Every contribution is appreciated.
about.contactBody: If you run into any issues or have questions about your PTO membership, please reach out to us. We're happy to help get you connected!

membership.title: Your membership. Your voice.
membership.intro: Both membership options support the PTO and give you access to member benefits. Choose the option that works best for your family!
membership.voiceBody: The Thrive PTO is led by a PTO Board and its members, and some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote. Your membership gives you a voice in those decisions.
membership.familyBody: Family Membership includes two voting members from your household, so two parents/guardians can participate in membership votes.
membership.individualBody: Individual Membership includes one voting member from your household.
membership.paymentNote: View current membership details and pricing, and complete your membership on FutureFund.
membership.contactBody: If you run into any issues or have questions about your PTO membership, please reach out. We're happy to help get you connected!

volunteer.title: Find your way to lend a hand.
volunteer.intro: Volunteers help make so many of the special moments at Thrive possible. Whether you have an hour to give or want to take on a larger role, we'd love to have you join us—but there's never any pressure. Every contribution is appreciated.
volunteer.areasTitle: A few ways to get involved
volunteer.formIntro: Choose your interests and send the PTO a message. You can ask questions or share how you'd like to help.
volunteer.formNote: This opens a draft in your email app for you to review and send to the PTO. Your details are not submitted or stored on this website.

support.title: A simple way to support the PTO.
support.intro: Explore the Thrive Center for Success store on FutureFund, or choose a PTO membership that works for your household.
